extension.description: Browse a remote server's file tree over SSH/SFTP based on ~/.ssh/config. No agent to install on the server.
command.connect.title: SSH Explorer: Connect to Host
command.openFolder.title: SSH Explorer: Open Remote Folder
command.openParent.title: SSH Explorer: Open Parent Folder
command.disconnect.title: SSH Explorer: Disconnect
command.refreshHosts.title: SSH Explorer: Refresh Host List
view.hosts.name: SSH Hosts
config.configPath.description: Path to the SSH config file to parse for host suggestions.
config.defaultRemotePath.description: Remote folder opened by default on connection ("." = the remote user's home directory).
config.connectTimeout.description: Maximum time to establish an SSH connection (ms).
config.keepaliveInterval.description: Interval between keepalive packets sent to maintain the connection (ms, 0 to disable).
config.statCacheTtl.description: How long file metadata (stat) is cached to reduce network round-trips (ms, 0 to disable).
